records.part: Handheld imaging system used by Port Investigators for package inspection
records.quantity: 1 year from issuance of original purchase order. Multiple purchase orders may be issued
records.reason: The Viken Detection handheld Nighthawk BTX/DTX X-ray is the only device on the market that can provide Backscatter and Transmission X-ray images through the use of it's DTX arm, which provides users a clear image of items consealed within a variety of enclosure types.
